№1.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favorite hobby.
№1.sovol_uz: Sevimli mashg‘ulotingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№1.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№1.jovob_en: This essay is about my favorite hobby. My hobby is reading books. I like reading because it is very interesting and useful. I usually read almost every day, especially in the evening. Reading books helps me learn new words, improve my English, and relax. In conclusion, I really like my hobby and it is very special for me.
№1.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening sevimli mashg‘ulotim haqida. Mening mashg‘ulotim kitob o‘qish. Men uni juda yoqtiraman, chunki bu qiziqarli va foydali. Men deyarli har kuni, ayniqsa kechqurun kitob o‘qiyman. Kitob o‘qish yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganishga, ingliz tilimni yaxshilashga va meni tinchlantirishga yordam beradi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men mashg‘ulotimni juda yoqtiraman va u mening uchun juda muhim.

№2.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your family.
№2.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№2.sovol_en_4: what they do (jobs, hobbies, or activities they like)
№2.sovol_uz_4: Ular nima ish qiladi yoki qanday mashg‘ulotlarni yoqtiradi
№2.jovob_en: This essay is about my family. There are five people in my family: my father, mother, brother, sister, and me. My father works in an office and my mother is a teacher. My brother likes football and my sister enjoys drawing. In the evening, we spend time together, eat dinner, and sometimes play games. In conclusion, I really love my family and it is very important for me.
№2.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening oilam haqida. Mening oilamda besh kishi bor: otam, onam, akam, singlim va men. Otam ofisda ishlaydi, onam o‘qituvchi. Akam futbolni yoqtiradi, singlim rasm chizishni yaxshi ko‘radi. Kechqurun birga vaqt o‘tkazamiz, ovqatlanamiz va ba’zida o‘yin o‘ynaymiz. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men oilamni juda yaxshi ko‘raman va u mening uchun juda muhim.

№3.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your school.
№3.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№3.sovol_en_5: the buildings (for example, football and basketball stadiums)
№3.jovob_en: This essay is about my school. I study at a big and modern school. My classmates are friendly and helpful. My teachers are kind and explain lessons clearly. Our school has a library and football and basketball stadiums. I like studying here because the school is comfortable and interesting. In conclusion, I really enjoy my school and it is very important to me.
№3.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening maktabim haqida. Men katta va zamonaviy maktabda o‘qiyman. Sinfdoshlarim do‘stona va yordam beradi. O‘qituvchilarim mehribon va darslarni aniq tushuntiradi. Maktabimizda kutubxona va futbol hamda basketbol maydonlari bor. Bu yerda o‘qishni yoqtiraman, chunki maktab qulay va qiziqarli. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men maktabimni juda yoqtiraman va u mening uchun juda muhim.

№4.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favourite holiday.
№4.sovol_uz: Sevimli bayramingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№4.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№4.sovol_en_5: what you do on that day
№4.jovob_en: This essay is about my favourite holiday. My favourite holiday is Eid. I like it because I spend time with family and relatives. We cook traditional food like plov, sweets, and desserts. On that day, we visit relatives, exchange gifts, and talk with each other. In conclusion, I really enjoy this holiday and it is very special for me.
№4.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening sevimli bayramim haqida. Mening sevimli bayramim Hayit. Men uni oilam va qarindoshlarim bilan vaqt o‘tkazish uchun yoqtiraman. Biz palov, shirinliklar va desertlar tayyorlaymiz. Shu kunda qarindoshlarni ziyorat qilamiz, sovg‘alar almashamiz va bir-birimiz bilan suhbat qilamiz. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men ushbu bayramni juda yoqtiraman va u mening uchun juda muhim.

№5.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your city.
№5.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№5.jovob_en: This essay is about my city. I live in a beautiful city. There are many markets where people buy fresh fruits and vegetables. The parks are green, clean, and peaceful. There are tall buildings, schools, and shops. Many people like my city because it is comfortable and friendly. In conclusion, I really like my city and it is very special for me.
№5.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening shahrim haqida. Men chiroyli shaharda yashayman. Bu yerda odamlar yangi meva va sabzavot sotib oladigan ko‘plab bozorlar bor. Bog‘lar yashil, toza va tinch. Shuningdek, baland binolar, maktablar va do‘konlar bor. Ko‘plab odamlar mening shahrimni qulay va do‘stona deb biladi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men shahrimni juda yoqtiraman va u mening uchun juda muhim.

№6.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your last birthday.
№6.sovol_uz: Oxirgi tug‘ilgan kuningiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№6.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№6.jovob_en: This essay is about my last birthday. It was in July. I celebrated it at home with my family and friends. We ate delicious food and a big chocolate cake. My friends gave me presents and we laughed, talked, and took many photos. In conclusion, I really enjoyed my last birthday and it was very special for me.
№6.jovob_uz: Bu insho oxirgi tug‘ilgan kunim haqida. U iyul oyida bo‘ldi. Men uni uyda oilam va do‘stlarim bilan nishonladim. Biz mazali ovqat va katta shokoladli tort yedik. Do‘stlarim sovg‘alar berdi va biz kuldik, suhbat qildik va ko‘p suratga tushdik. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men oxirgi tug‘ilgan kunimni juda yoqtirdim va u mening uchun juda muhim edi.

№7.sovol_en: Write a small essay about a place you like.
№7.sovol_uz: Yoqtirgan joyingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№7.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№7.jovob_en: This essay is about a place I like. One place I like is the park near my house. It is very close to my home. There are many trees, flowers, and benches. People walk, play, and relax there. I usually go there to breathe fresh air, enjoy nature, and sometimes read a book. In conclusion, I really like this place and it is very special for me.
№7.jovob_uz: Bu insho men yoqtiradigan joy haqida. Men yoqtiradigan joylardan biri uyim yaqinidagi bog‘. U uyimga juda yaqin. Bu yerda ko‘p daraxtlar, gullar va skameykalar bor. Odamlar sayr qiladi, o‘ynaydi va dam oladi. Men odatda u yerga toza havo olish, tabiatdan zavqlanish va ba’zan kitob o‘qish uchun boraman. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men ushbu joyni juda yoqtiraman va u mening uchun juda muhim.

№8.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your house or flat.
№8.sovol_uz: Uyingiz yoki kvartirangiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№8.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№8.sovol_en_5: what you like about your house/flat
№8.jovob_en: This essay is about my house. I live in a comfortable house with four rooms: a living room, two bedrooms, and a kitchen. My favorite room is my bedroom because I can study, read, and rest there. I like my house because it is clean, quiet, and cozy. In conclusion, I really enjoy my house and it is very special for me.
№8.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening uyim haqida. Men qulay uyda yashayman. Unda to‘rtta xona bor: mehmonxona, ikkita yotoqxona va oshxona. Mening sevimli xonam yotoqxonam, chunki u yerda o‘qiyman, kitob o‘qiyman va dam olaman. Men uyni toza, tinch va qulay deb bilaman. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men uyni juda yoqtiraman va u mening uchun juda muhim.

№9.sovol_en: Write a small essay about yourself.
№9.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№9.jovob_en: This essay is about me. My name is Elyor and I am 20 years old. I am from Uzbekistan. I am friendly, hardworking, and curious. I like reading books, learning English, and spending time with friends. In conclusion, I really like myself and I think I am special for me.
№9.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening o‘zim haqida. Mening ismim Elyor va men 20 yoshdaman. Men O‘zbekistondanman. Men do‘stona, mehnatsevar va qiziquvchanman. Men kitob o‘qishni, ingliz tilini o‘rganishni va do‘stlar bilan vaqt o‘tkazishni yaxshi ko‘raman. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men o‘zimni juda yoqtiraman va u mening uchun juda muhim.

№10.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favorite thing.
№10.sovol_uz: Sevimli narsangiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№10.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№10.sovol_en_4: who gave it to you or where you got it
№10.jovob_en: This essay is about my favorite thing. My favorite thing is my smartphone. I use it to study English, communicate with friends, and watch videos. It helps me in my daily life and keeps me organized. I like it because it is very useful and convenient. In conclusion, I really enjoy it and it is very special for me.
№10.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening sevimli narsam haqida. Mening sevimli narsam smartfonim. Men undan ingliz tilini o‘rganish, do‘stlar bilan gaplashish va videolar tomosha qilish uchun foydalanaman. U kundalik hayotimda menga yordam beradi va kunimni tartibga soladi. Men uni juda foydali va qulay deb bilaman. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men uni juda yoqtiraman va u mening uchun juda muhim.
